root_cause: “reads the store, then charges the gateway, then inserts a payment”; “synchronizes each lookup and insert individually” distinguishes workflow from operation locks.
execution_evidence: “Request A” and “Request B” each find no payment; “Both pass the test seam and call gateway.charge”; “Each inserts a payment row.”
correction: “unique constraint on payments.order_id”; only successful claimant may charge; conflict loser reads existing row; pending claim is inserted before external call.
retry_failure_semantics: “reuse the same durable key”; “resume or reconcile the existing pending attempt”; provider behavior cannot be inferred and exactly-once cannot be established.
regression_test_tradeoffs: Test requires one claimant/call and uncertain-outcome retry with persisted key/no second charge; crash window requires reconciliation or documented provider contract.

root_cause: Calls it a “check-then-act race”; lookup, gateway call, and insert “are not one atomic operation.”
execution_evidence: Numbered A/B absent lookups, both gateway calls with order-41, and both inserts; existing test observes “two calls and two rows.”
correction: “atomically claim the order”; unique order_id constraint, pending row, creator alone calls, loser loads existing; warns lookup/insert transaction alone is insufficient.
retry_failure_semantics: Timeout leaves “unknown/pending”; retry “must not blindly issue another charge”; requires supported outcome determination or documented gateway guarantee.
regression_test_tradeoffs: Two-thread claim test asserts one call and one record; no explicit ambiguous-timeout retry recovery assertion.

root_cause: Labels it “check, charge, insert”; individual store synchronization does not make the sequence atomic.
execution_evidence: Six-step timeline: both lookups absent, both call gateway, both insert; repeated key is not deduplicated.
correction: Short committed in_progress claim, UNIQUE(order_id), winner-only dispatch, conflict loser reads status, production coordination across processes.
retry_failure_semantics: Preserve uncertainty; retry returns pending/unknown without charging; needs explicitly established provider deduplication or reconciliation; no exactly-once promise.
regression_test_tradeoffs: Asserts one invocation, one payment, success and no extra call on retry; warns barrier placement and explains stranded-attempt tradeoff.

root_cause: Calls out “check-then-act race”; individual synchronization does not cover the whole operation.

correction: Durable attempt before gateway, UNIQUE(order_id), atomic insert/conflict handling, commit before gateway, DB coordination across processes.

regression_test_tradeoffs: Barrier test expects one call/attempt and retry returns stored success; covers the crash-before/after charge limitation.
